sessions.title: A Collocations using the word time
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ cố định sử dụng từ 'time'.
sessions.value:
# Time

## A Collocations using the word time

| collocation             | example                                                                                   | comment                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **spend time**              | I **spent some time** in South America when I was younger.                                    | NOT passed in this context – though you can say things like reading passes the time. |
| **waste time**, **save time**   | Don’t do it like that. You’re **wasting time**. You’ll **save time** if you do it like this.      | Spend, waste and save are often used with money as well as time.                     |
| **tell someone the time**   | Can you **tell me the time**, please? I left my watch at home.                                | NOT tell the hour                                                                    |
| **free/spare time**         | What do you like to do in your **free/spare time**?                                           | Both expressions refer to the time when you are not working.                         |
| **have time to**            | I’m sorry, I didn’t **have time to** do my homework.                                          | Compare: Jo doesn’t have time for lazy people. [has no patience with]                |
| **make time to**            | The doctor’s very busy but he’ll try to **make time** for you.                                | Make here has a simple meaning of create.                                            |
| **kill time**               | We got to the airport very early, so we had a meal in the restaurant to **kill (some) time**. | to fill in the time while you are waiting to do something you have planned           |
| **take your time**          | No need to hurry – you can **take your time**.                                                | This means you can be as long as you wish.                                           |
| **bang/dead/right on time** | The train left **bang/dead/right on time**.                                                   | Exactly on time – the first two are very informal.                                   |

Here are some other useful expressions relating to time.
We had a **good/great time** at the party. [NOT spent a great time]
Lena had the **time of her life** in Brazil.
Your attitude to work may change a bit **as time goes by / as time passes**.
I couldn’t finish the exam because I **ran out of time**.
You’ll be sorry **big time** for speaking to me like that! [informal: extremely]

sessions.title: B Past and future
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ liên quan đến quá khứ và tương lai.
sessions.value:
The **past few weeks** have been really difficult for Tina’s two **grown-up children**. They’re both at university writing dissertations. Her son’s is on **early 21st century** fiction while her daughter’s is about life in **prehistoric times** – she’s not interested in the **recent past** at all. They are both working very hard. They are nearly finished but there are lots of **last-minute things** left to do. They **set their alarms** for **five o’clock** and **get up** as soon as the **alarm goes off**. They work from **dawn till dusk** and indeed sometimes they stay up until the **small hours**. Tina can’t wait until the story working such **ungodly hours**?. It’s taking them ages to complete the work but Tina is sure it will eventually all be **worth their while**. She is sure they both have a **great future** **ahead of them**. She thinks they will both get **academic jobs** in the **not too distant future**. Of course, no one can know what the **future holds**, but I hope she is right.

1 **all day**
2 **early morning hours** (2, 3, 4 a.m.)
3 **unreasonably late or early hours**
4 **worth the time spent**

senses.definition_vi: Dành thời gian cho một hoạt động hoặc ở một địa điểm.
examples: I spent some time in South America when I was younger.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Không dùng 'passed' trong ngữ cảnh này, mặc dù bạn có thể nói 'reading passes the time'.

use_prompts.question: Do young people today stay with their grandparents enough?
Is it better to stay in one country for a long time or visit many briefly?
How many hours a day do teenagers use their phones?

dictation.text: I like to spend time with my family at weekends.

paraphrase.source: Children today use many hours every day on video games.
paraphrase.model: Children today spend a lot of time on video games every day.

paraphrase.source: When I was younger, I lived in Japan for a while.
paraphrase.model: When I was younger, I spent some time in Japan.

senses.definition_vi: Sử dụng thời gian một cách không hiệu quả hoặc lãng phí.
examples: Don’t do it like that. You’re wasting time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Spend, waste và save thường được dùng với cả tiền bạc và thời gian.

use_prompts.question: What activities at work are not useful at all?
Is social media a useless activity for young people?
Why do some students study for hours but learn little?

dictation.text: Do not waste time on things that do not matter.

paraphrase.source: Long meetings without a plan use up hours for nothing.
paraphrase.model: Long meetings without a plan waste time.

paraphrase.source: Many students lose hours looking at their phones instead of studying.
paraphrase.model: Many students waste time looking at their phones instead of studying.

senses.definition_vi: Tiết kiệm thời gian bằng cách làm việc hiệu quả hơn hoặc sử dụng phương pháp tốt hơn.
examples: You’ll save time if you do it like this.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Spend, waste và save thường được dùng với cả tiền bạc và thời gian.

use_prompts.question: How has technology made everyday tasks quicker?
Is it better to fly or take the train between nearby cities?
Why do busy families buy ready meals?

dictation.text: Online banking can save time every week.

paraphrase.source: Buying ready meals means busy parents spend fewer hours cooking.
paraphrase.model: Buying ready meals helps busy parents save time on cooking.

paraphrase.source: Taking the fast train is quicker than driving to the city.
paraphrase.model: You can save time by taking the fast train instead of driving.

senses.definition_vi: Cho ai đó biết bây giờ là mấy giờ.
examples: Can you tell me the time, please? I left my watch at home.

use_prompts.question: Do young people still wear watches, or do they use phones to check the hour?
Is it polite to ask strangers questions when you are abroad?
Are people in your city happy to help strangers in the street?

dictation.text: Excuse me, could you tell me the time?

paraphrase.source: An old man stopped me and asked what time it was.
paraphrase.model: An old man stopped me and asked me to tell him the time.

paraphrase.source: My phone was dead, so I asked a stranger what hour it was.
paraphrase.model: My phone was dead, so I asked a stranger to tell me the time.

senses.definition_vi: Thời gian rảnh rỗi, thời gian không phải làm việc.
examples: What do you like to do in your free time?
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cả hai cách diễn đạt 'free time' và 'spare time' đều đề cập đến thời gian khi bạn không làm việc.

use_prompts.question: What do families in your country do when they are not working?
Do people today have enough hours away from work?
Should students have more hours without homework?

dictation.text: I like to read books in my free time.

paraphrase.source: When she is not working, she enjoys painting.
paraphrase.model: In her free time, she enjoys painting.

paraphrase.source: Many students have very few hours without classes or homework.
paraphrase.model: Many students have very little free time.

senses.definition_vi: Thời gian rảnh rỗi, thời gian không phải làm việc.
examples: What do you like to do in your spare time?
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cả hai cách diễn đạt 'free time' và 'spare time' đều đề cập đến thời gian khi bạn không làm việc.

use_prompts.question: What hobbies are popular among young people in your country?
Is it important for workers to have hobbies outside their job?
How can people use their hours away from work to stay healthy?

dictation.text: He plays the guitar in his spare time.

paraphrase.source: When he is not at work, he goes running in the park.
paraphrase.model: In his spare time, he goes running in the park.

paraphrase.source: Many busy parents have very little time for themselves.
paraphrase.model: Many busy parents have very little spare time.

senses.definition_vi: Có đủ thời gian để làm gì đó.
examples: I’m sorry, I didn’t have time to do my homework.
senses.usage_notes_vi: So sánh: Jo doesn’t have time for lazy people. [không có kiên nhẫn với người lười biếng]

use_prompts.question: Do working parents get enough chances to cook healthy meals?
Why do many people not exercise regularly?
Why do some students not finish their homework?

dictation.text: I did not have time to eat breakfast today.

paraphrase.source: Many workers are too busy to cook a proper lunch.
paraphrase.model: Many workers do not have time to cook a proper lunch.

paraphrase.source: Busy parents are often unable to find enough hours to play with their children.
paraphrase.model: Busy parents often do not have time to play with their children.

senses.definition_vi: Cố gắng sắp xếp thời gian để làm gì đó, ngay cả khi bận rộn.
examples: The doctor’s very busy but he’ll try to make time for you.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Từ 'make' ở đây có nghĩa đơn giản là 'tạo ra'.

use_prompts.question: How can busy parents still find moments for their children?
Why should busy people find a way to exercise?
Should people find hours in their busy lives to help their community?

dictation.text: You should make time to call your parents.

paraphrase.source: Even when she is busy, she finds a moment to read to her son.
paraphrase.model: Even when she is busy, she makes time to read to her son.

paraphrase.source: Doctors say we should plan our day so that we can exercise.
paraphrase.model: Doctors say we should make time to exercise.

senses.definition_vi: Làm gì đó để giết thời gian trong khi chờ đợi một sự kiện hoặc hoạt động đã lên kế hoạch.
examples: We got to the airport very early, so we had a meal in the restaurant to kill (some) time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Để lấp đầy thời gian trong khi bạn đang chờ đợi để làm điều gì đó bạn đã lên kế hoạch.

use_prompts.question: What do you do while waiting at an airport?
How do people use their phones while waiting for something?
Do people go to shopping centres just to pass the hours?

dictation.text: We played cards to kill time at the station.

paraphrase.source: We arrived early, so we walked around the shops while we waited.
paraphrase.model: We arrived early, so we walked around the shops to kill time.

paraphrase.source: Many people look at social media just to pass the time while waiting.
paraphrase.model: Many people look at social media just to kill time while waiting.

senses.definition_vi: Không cần vội vàng, cứ làm từ từ.
examples: No need to hurry – you can take your time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Điều này có nghĩa là bạn có thể dành bao lâu tùy thích.

use_prompts.question: Should people think carefully before buying expensive things?
Should students rush through their exams?
Do people in your country eat their meals slowly?

dictation.text: There is no hurry, so take your time.

paraphrase.source: Do not rush when you choose a house; think carefully.
paraphrase.model: Take your time when you choose a house.

paraphrase.source: You do not need to hurry with your exam answers.
paraphrase.model: You can take your time with your exam answers.

senses.definition_vi: Đúng giờ một cách chính xác, không sai lệch.
examples: The train left bang on time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chính xác đúng giờ – 'bang' và 'dead' là rất thân mật.

use_prompts.question: Is public transport in your country usually punctual?

dictation.text: The train arrived bang on time.

paraphrase.model: The bus came bang on time.

paraphrase.source: She always arrives at work at exactly nine.
paraphrase.model: She always arrives at work bang on time.

senses.definition_vi: Đúng giờ một cách chính xác, không sai lệch.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Chính xác đúng giờ – 'bang' và 'dead' là rất thân mật.

use_prompts.question: Are trains in your country punctual?

senses.definition_vi: Trải qua một khoảng thời gian vui vẻ, thú vị.
